title: chore(babel): migrate to Babel 7
body:
This migrates from Babel 6 to Babel 7.

I took this opportunity to update all Babel and Rollup dependencies.

Note that the production bundle increased from _77.32 KB_ to _77.7 KB_ because Babel 7 becomes more spec-compliant.
